notes.subject: חנמל (hanamal)
notes.rationale: Hapax legomenon: 'ais i pundaun' (KJV frost), 'bikpela ais ston' (Geneva hailstone), o 'ol binatang smol bilong kai-kai diwai' (aphis) — man i no save stret wanem em i min

notes.subject: חנמל
notes.rationale: Tok i stap long Tanakh long dispela ples tasol

translation: Em i kilim ⟨את⟩ ol wainpela diwai bilong ol wantaim ais i pundaun, na ⟨את⟩ ol siko-mor diwai bilong ol wantaim kol tru bilong krankraun.

tokens.gloss: na ol siko-mor diwai bilong ol
